name: @oscharko-dev/keiko-for-quality
description: Hardened, evidence-disciplined pull-request reviewer bot built on the Open Code Review engine.

scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/corpus-lcov.info --test corpus/*.test.mjs && node scripts/filter-lcov.mjs coverage/corpus-lcov.info corpus/ && cat coverage/corpus-lcov.info >> coverage/lcov.info && node --import ./widget/test/ts-hooks.mjs --experimental-test-coverage --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/widget-lcov.info --test widget/test/*.test.mjs && cat coverage/widget-lcov.info >> coverage/lcov.info
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:widget && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run test:corpus && npm run test:widget && npm run test:scripts && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
